title: Al-Kahf 18:1 to 10: tadabbur before the exams: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Understanding the Qur'an and teaching
source: Written for quran/y11 lesson 23 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Kahf 18 rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 23. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: أَمْ حَسِبْتَ أَنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْكَهْفِ وَٱلرَّقِيمِ كَانُوا۟ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا عَجَبًا (٩) إِذْ أَوَى ٱلْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى ٱلْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةًۭ وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًۭا (١٠)

panels.title: The du'a of 18:10
points: Said by young people under pressure

questions.q: In the portal response box, write how you will use the du'a of 18:10 this exam season. Start: 'When I feel pressure, I will ...'
questions.a: For example: 'When I feel pressure, I will make this du'a before each paper and then do my best.'

questions.q: Tadabbur (Forms long answer): what do 18:1 to 10 teach about trusting Allah when young? Use one ayah as evidence. Start: 'Al-Kahf teaches young believers ...'
questions.a: A paragraph with one cited ayah and a personal link.

questions.q: Extend: recite 18:1 to 10 to a partner with the saktah.
In 18:10 the young people asked Allah for ...
questions.a: A) mercy and right guidance. 18:10: 'Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.'

questions.q: Think again: The young people of the cave were few, under pressure and far from home. What did they do first?
questions.a: They made du'a: 'Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself and prepare for us right guidance' (18:10).
